contract: construct() -> distinct integers in 1..284 containing 1, 2, 5 and 11 whose pairwise sums a + b (a <= b) are all distinct. Maximize the size; without the prescribed elements the maximum in [1, 284] is 20 (the optimal 20-mark Golomb ruler has length 283).
notes: Scores near 20 would show that the prescribed elements barely reduce the attainable size at this scale; no value for this seed is documented.
